result.title: MonoQPM: Splitting Features into Concepts for Inherent Interpretability and Predictive Performance
result.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (10/2026). OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=8bQNRlFQhZ
result.summary: Alongside superposition, polysemanticity is one of the primary obstacles to achieving interpretable deep neural networks. While these phenomena are typically intrinsically linked, the Quadratic Programming Enhanced Model (QPM) naturally decouples them. By representing classes with a sparse binary assignment of very few features, QPM prevents superposition by design on its final features but still exhibits polysemanticity. However, measuring polysemanticity is an open problem. This work proposes a utility-focused approach to measuring polysemanticity by quantifying the decrease in interference-induced activation errors, which yields the practical utility of tighter prediction sets using Conformal Prediction (CP). We explicitly disentangle the polysemantic features of QPM into monosemantic concepts to create the Monosemantic QPM (MonoQPM). Because its features are disentangled, MonoQPM acts as a significantly more efficient Conformal Predictor. Additionally, we introduce CUBCars, a dataset providing ground truth information about shared concepts. Using this and other datasets, we demonstrate that polysemanticity emerges in QPM across all tested architectures, but is effectively alleviated by MonoQPM. For instance, MonoQPM guarantees 88% coverage using Adaptive Prediction Sets on ImageNet with just 66% of the frozen QPM's set size.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出以干扰导致的激活误差下降来度量 polysemanticity 的效用视角，并把 QPM 的多义特征拆分为单义概念构成 MonoQPM，从而在 Conformal Prediction 下获得更紧的预测集，同时发布带共享概念真值的 CUBCars 数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「概念级解耦＋干扰误差度量」或可作为诊断 latent 视觉状态是否叠加多义信息、以及视觉细节是否被混淆保留的观测手段，但与多模态推理无直接联系，可供核查。
